tools.name: watch
tools.description: Watches a GitHub pull request in pr-watch and returns what it shows now. Its line above the prompt follows its checks, and pr-watch tells you in this conversation, as /config allows, when a check fails, it has conflicts or requested changes, or someone comments or reviews. That it turned ready to merge, or its merge's checks passed, comes with the user's next message, unless review-cycle lets you merge unasked. Pull requests you open with gh pr create, or merge with gh pr merge and a number, URL or branch, are watched already; use this for any other you are waiting on, instead of polling gh pr checks or sleeping.

tools.name: unwatch
tools.description: Stops pr-watch watching a pull request (its number, URL or head branch) or a pushed branch, once you no longer need its news.

tools.name: watches
tools.description: Lists what pr-watch is watching, each with what its line shows now. Read-only.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
